FAQ

Common questions.

Is my contact list saved?
Yes — Contacts is the one Workblox Business tool that stores data, because it's a contact list. Your contacts are kept with your account. See the Privacy Policy.
What happens if I turn the tool off?
Your contacts aren't deleted. They're waiting for you if you add Contacts back later.
Can I share contacts with someone else?
Workblox Business is single-user, so the list is yours. You can export contacts as a PDF or vCard file to share them.
What does it cost?
Contacts is part of Workblox Business. You pick your tools and pay by how many: $25/mo for 1–3 tools, $40/mo for 4–7 tools, or $75/mo for 8–16 tools, with a 7-day free trial.
